technique.finding.within_error: The deviation is smaller than the measurement error (±{unc}{unit}). Measure again before changing anything.
technique.warn.low_detection: The person was seen in only {pct} % of the frames. Check the light and that the whole body is in the picture.
technique.bikefit.warn.low_fps: The film has {fps} frames/s. At 90 rpm the crank then turns more than 10° between two frames, and the bottom of the stroke can fall between frames. Film at 60 frames/s or more.
technique.bikefit.warn.no_cyclist: No cyclist was found in the film.
technique.bikefit.warn.no_revolutions: The pedal revolutions could not be found reliably (only {n} whole revolutions). Nothing is judged from this film. Check that the foot and the whole leg are visible and that the camera is square to the side.
technique.bikefit.warn.few_revolutions: Only {n} whole pedal revolutions were found. Film at least 20 seconds of steady pedalling.
technique.bikefit.warn.circle: The ankle's path deviates {pct} % from a circle. The crank positions, and the values taken in them, are less certain than usual.
technique.bikefit.warn.uneven: The cadence varies {pct} % between revolutions. Film at a steady pace after the warm-up.
technique.bikefit.warn.leg_hidden: The hip, knee and ankle were clearly visible in only {pct} % of the frames. Tight clothing and better light give more reliable angles.
technique.bikefit.warn.direction: The direction of the pedalling does not match the way the body faces in the picture. Check that the right side is chosen and that the film is not mirrored.
technique.bikefit.warn.facing: The cyclist faces the other way than the chosen camera view. The analysis follows what the film shows.
technique.bikefit.warn.arms_hidden: The elbow and the wrist were not visible enough, so the arm's angles are not shown and the stem cannot be judged from the film.
technique.bikefit.warn.front_hip: From the front the bars and the hands hide the hips. Only the knee's track is judged, not the movement of the pelvis.
technique.bikefit.warn.extremes: Video often underestimates the extreme positions, and hip and knee angles carry an error of about ±{unc}°. Check the knee angle with a goniometer before the saddle is locked.
technique.bikefit.finding.saddle.title: Saddle height
technique.bikefit.finding.saddle.ok: The knee is flexed {value}° at the bottom of the stroke. That is within the reference range for video while pedalling.
technique.bikefit.finding.saddle.problem: The knee is flexed {value}° at the bottom of the stroke, more than the reference range. The saddle is probably too low, which loads the front of the knee.
The knee is flexed only {value}° at the bottom of the stroke, less than the reference range. The saddle is probably too high: the leg is almost straight and the hip has to help.
technique.bikefit.finding.saddle.cue: Change the saddle height as suggested, 3–5 mm at a time, and film again after every change.
technique.bikefit.finding.knee_top.title: The knee at the top
technique.bikefit.finding.knee_top.probl: The knee is flexed {value}° at the top of the stroke. That is a lot, and the knee is compressed as the downstroke begins.
technique.bikefit.finding.knee_top.cue: Raise the saddle if the bottom of the stroke allows it. Otherwise shorter cranks can open the knee.
technique.bikefit.finding.hip_closed.pro: The angle between the trunk and the thigh is {value}° at the top of the stroke. The hip is closed and the thigh comes close to the trunk.
technique.bikefit.finding.hip_closed.cue: A higher or closer handlebar opens the hip. So can shorter cranks.
technique.bikefit.finding.hip_rock.title: The hip rocks
technique.bikefit.finding.hip_rock.probl: The hip moves {value} cm up and down per revolution. A rocking hip is often a sign that the saddle is too high.
technique.bikefit.finding.hip_rock.cue: Watch the hips from behind while pedalling, and lower the saddle a few millimetres if the pelvis tips.
technique.bikefit.finding.trunk.title: Trunk angle
technique.bikefit.finding.trunk.ok: The trunk is at {value}° to the horizontal, a common position on a road bike with the hands on the hoods.
technique.bikefit.finding.trunk.problem_: The trunk is at {value}° to the horizontal, a low position. It only works if the back stays straight and the neck relaxed.
The trunk is at {value}° to the horizontal, an upright position. It is comfortable but gives more drag and more weight on the saddle.
technique.bikefit.finding.trunk.cue: Ask how the position feels after an hour. The handlebar height and the stem length change the trunk angle.
technique.bikefit.finding.reach.title: Reach to the handlebar
technique.bikefit.finding.reach.ok: The elbow is flexed {elbow}° and the shoulder angle is {shoulder}°. The arms are slightly bent and do not carry too much weight.
technique.bikefit.finding.reach.problem_: The elbow is flexed {elbow}° and the shoulder angle is {shoulder}°. The arms are nearly straight or reach far forward, so the handlebar is probably too far away or too low.
The elbow is flexed {elbow}° and the shoulder angle is {shoulder}°. The arms are very bent and the shoulder closed, so the handlebar is probably too close.
technique.bikefit.finding.reach.cue: See the recommendation on the stem. Try the change on a longer ride before parts are replaced.
technique.bikefit.finding.knee_track.ok: The knees track straight over the feet: at most {value} cm sideways per revolution.
technique.bikefit.finding.knee_track.pro: {side_word} knee moves {value} cm sideways per revolution and falls inwards in the downstroke.
{side_word} knee moves {value} cm sideways per revolution and goes outwards at the top.
technique.bikefit.finding.knee_track.cue: Check the cleat's rotation, the stance width and the foot's support in the shoe. A knee that goes outwards at the top can also come from a saddle that is too low.
technique.bikefit.advice.saddle_height.u: The saddle height cannot be judged from this film. Film again from the side as the warnings say.
technique.bikefit.advice.saddle_height.k: Keep the saddle height. The knee is flexed {value}° at the bottom of the stroke, within the reference range 33–43°.
technique.bikefit.advice.saddle_height.c: The knee angle ({value}°) is within the reference range, but the hip rocks {rock} cm per revolution. Check the saddle height with a goniometer and watch the pelvis from behind before changing anything.
technique.bikefit.advice.saddle_height.r: Raise the saddle {lo}–{hi} mm. The knee is flexed {value}° at the bottom of the stroke, {dev}° above the reference range. {lo} mm brings the knee to the edge of the range and {hi} mm to its middle. Change at most {step} mm at a time and film again.
technique.bikefit.advice.saddle_height.l: Lower the saddle {lo}–{hi} mm. The knee is flexed {value}° at the bottom of the stroke, {dev}° below the reference range. {lo} mm brings the knee to the edge of the range and {hi} mm to its middle. Change at most {step} mm at a time and film again.
technique.bikefit.advice.saddle_height.r: The saddle may be too low: the knee is flexed {value}°, {dev}° above the reference range. The measurement is uncertain or the deviation smaller than the measurement error (±{unc}°). Measure with a goniometer first. If it holds: raise {step} mm and film again.
technique.bikefit.advice.saddle_height.l: The saddle may be too high: the knee is flexed {value}°, {dev}° below the reference range. The measurement is uncertain or the deviation smaller than the measurement error (±{unc}°). Measure with a goniometer first. If it holds: lower {step} mm and film again.
technique.bikefit.advice.cleat.title: Cleats
technique.bikefit.advice.cleat.manual: The fore-aft position of the cleat cannot be read reliably from video, because the pedal axle is not a measured point. Set it by hand with the checklist: mark the ball of the foot on the shoe and place it over the pedal axle.
technique.bikefit.advice.cleat.unknown: The knee's track cannot be judged from this film. Film again from the front as the warnings say.
technique.bikefit.advice.cleat.keep: The knees track straight (at most {value} cm sideways). The film gives no reason to rotate the cleats or change the stance width.
technique.bikefit.advice.cleat.check_in: {side} knee falls inwards in the downstroke ({value} cm sideways). Check the cleat's rotation so the foot gets its natural direction, try a wider stance and review the foot's support (insole or wedge). Film again after the change.
technique.bikefit.advice.cleat.check_out: {side} knee goes outwards at the top ({value} cm sideways). Check the cleat's rotation and try a narrower stance. Check the saddle height too: a knee that goes outwards at the top can come from a saddle that is too low.
technique.bikefit.advice.stem.title: Stem
technique.bikefit.advice.stem.unknown: The stem cannot be judged from the film, because the arm was not visible enough.
technique.bikefit.advice.stem.keep: No change is suggested. The elbow is flexed {elbow}° and the shoulder angle is {shoulder}°.
technique.bikefit.advice.stem.shorter: Try a shorter stem (10 mm shorter is a common first step) or a higher handlebar. The elbow is flexed {elbow}° and the shoulder angle is {shoulder}°: the arms are stretched. The values are rules of thumb, so try before you buy.
technique.bikefit.advice.stem.longer: Try a longer stem (10 mm longer is a common first step). The elbow is flexed {elbow}° and the shoulder angle is {shoulder}°: the position is cramped. The values are rules of thumb, so try before you buy.
technique.bikefit.advice.stem.higher: Try a higher handlebar (spacers under the stem or a stem with more rise). The hip angle is {hip}° at the top of the stroke, so the hip is closed. The value is a rule of thumb, so try before you buy.
technique.bikefit.kf.caption.bottom: The leg is at its straightest. The knee angle here decides the saddle height.
technique.bikefit.kf.caption.top: The knee is at its most flexed and the hip at its most closed.
technique.bikefit.kf.caption.forward: The plumb line from the knee towards the pedal. The distance is shown without a verdict, because the pedal axle is not a measured point.
technique.bikefit.kf.caption.posture: The trunk's angle to the horizontal, the shoulder angle and the elbow's flexion.
technique.bikefit.kf.caption.sequence: One pedal revolution in four positions. The curve is the ankle's path.
technique.bikefit.kf.caption.front_track: The curves are the knees' paths over ten revolutions. The dashed lines run from hip to ankle.
technique.bikefit.label.kops: Knee {value} cm ahead of the pedal axle (±2 cm)
technique.ski.warn.low_fps: The film has {fps} frames/s. The drive takes about 0.6 s, so its start and finish and the order of trunk and arms become uncertain. Film at 60 frames/s or more.
technique.ski.warn.side_only: Double poling is only analysed from the side. Put the camera square to the plane of the pull.
technique.ski.warn.no_skier: No person was found in the film.
technique.ski.warn.no_strokes: The strokes could not be found reliably (only {n} whole strokes). Nothing is judged from this film. Check that the hands are visible all the way, also at the top.
technique.ski.warn.few_strokes: Only {n} whole strokes were found. Film at least 30 seconds at a steady rate.
technique.ski.warn.uneven: The rate varies {pct} % between strokes. Film at a steady rate after the warm-up.
technique.ski.warn.arm_hidden: The shoulder, elbow and wrist were clearly visible in only {pct} % of the frames. The arm's angles are less certain than usual.
technique.ski.warn.short_travel: The hand travels a short way in the picture. Check that the hands are visible at the top and that the camera is square to the side.
technique.ski.warn.facing: The athlete faces the other way than the chosen camera view. The analysis follows what the film shows.
technique.ski.finding.hand_height.title: Hand height at the start
technique.ski.finding.hand_height.ok: The hands start {value} cm above the nose, just above eye level as Concept2 describes.
technique.ski.finding.hand_height.proble: The hands start {value} cm above the nose. Reaching too high is one of the common errors: the shoulders have to begin the pull before the trunk can help.
The hands start {value} cm above the nose, which is low. The pull then gets short and the body weight does not join in.
technique.ski.finding.hand_height.cue.pr: Start with the hands just above the eyes and the elbows bent, not with straight arms overhead.
Stand up fully between strokes, onto your toes, and let the hands reach above eye level.
technique.ski.finding.hand_height.drill: Ten easy strokes with a stop at the start: check that the hands are at eye level before you pull.
technique.ski.finding.elbow_start.title: The elbow at the start
technique.ski.finding.elbow_start.ok: The elbow is at {value}° when the drive begins. Bent, firm arms pass the trunk's force on to the handles.
technique.ski.finding.elbow_start.proble: The elbow is at {value}° when the drive begins, almost straight. The lever gets long, the shoulders take the load and the trunk does not join in.
The elbow is at {value}° when the drive begins, very bent. The hands end up near the face and the pull gets short.
technique.ski.finding.elbow_start.cue.pr: Bend the elbows to about 90° and lock them. Hang your body weight in the handles.
Let the hands start a little in front of the face, with the elbow at about a right angle.
technique.ski.finding.elbow_start.drill: Strokes with locked elbows: only the trunk folds, the arms do not move. 3 × 10 strokes.
technique.ski.finding.trunk.title: Trunk fold
technique.ski.finding.trunk.ok: The trunk is folded {value}° from the vertical at the finish. The trunk does a large part of the work.
technique.ski.finding.trunk.problem_shal: The trunk is folded only {value}° from the vertical at the finish. The arms then pull almost alone, and they tire quickly.
technique.ski.finding.trunk.problem_deep: The trunk is folded {value}° from the vertical at the finish. That deep the stroke becomes a deadlift: the recovery gets long and the lower back is loaded.
technique.ski.finding.trunk.cue.problem_: Start the pull with the abdomen: fold the trunk forward and let the arms follow.
Stop when the hands reach the thighs. Keep the back straight and do not push the hips back.
technique.ski.finding.trunk.drill: Standing trunk folds without handles, hands on the thighs: fold to about 45° and stand up. 2 × 15.
technique.ski.finding.hip_hinge.title: The hip hinge
technique.ski.finding.hip_hinge.problem: The hip is flexed {value}° at the finish, with the knee flexed {knee}°. The pull comes more from the knees than from the hips.
technique.ski.finding.hip_hinge.cue: Hinge at the hips first and keep the knees soft. Think of bringing the chest down towards the handles.
technique.ski.finding.hip_hinge.drill: Hip hinge to a wall: stand a foot length from the wall and reach it with your hips without bending the knees more. 2 × 12.
technique.ski.finding.knee_squat.title: Knee bend at the finish
technique.ski.finding.knee_squat.problem: The knee is flexed {value}° at the finish. That is more than soft knees: the stroke becomes a squat, and the body drops without pulling the handles.
technique.ski.finding.knee_squat.cue: Hinge at the hips, soft knees. The knees bend a little, last, and never deeper than a quarter squat.
technique.ski.finding.knee_squat.drill: Strokes in front of a mirror from the side: see that the hips move back, not down. 3 × 10 easy strokes.
technique.ski.finding.sequence.title: Trunk before arms
technique.ski.finding.sequence.ok: The trunk begins to fold {lead} ms before the elbow extends. The order is right: the trunk starts the pull and the arms finish it.
technique.ski.finding.sequence.problem: The elbow begins to extend {lead} ms before the trunk folds. That is an arm pull: the small muscles do the work and the power gets low.
technique.ski.finding.sequence.cue: Keep the elbow angle locked until the hands are at chest height. Extend the arms only then.
technique.ski.finding.sequence.drill: Three-part stroke: 1) trunk only, 2) trunk and then arms, 3) the whole stroke. 3 × 8 of each.
technique.ski.finding.rhythm.title: Rhythm of drive and recovery
technique.ski.finding.rhythm.ok: The drive takes {drive} ms and the recovery {recovery} ms at {rate} strokes/min. The recovery is {value} times as long as the drive, so there is time to rest between strokes.
technique.ski.finding.rhythm.problem: The drive takes {drive} ms and the recovery {recovery} ms at {rate} strokes/min. The recovery is only {value} times as long as the drive: the rate is hurried and there is no time to rest between strokes.
technique.ski.finding.rhythm.cue: Pull fast and stand up calmly. Count "one" in the drive and "two, three" in the recovery.
technique.ski.finding.rhythm.drill: 2 minutes at a low rate (30–35 strokes/min) at the same pace per 500 m: powerful drives and a long recovery.
technique.ski.kf.caption.start: The hands are at their highest. The dashed line runs through the nose: the hands should start just above it.
technique.ski.kf.caption.mid_drive: The hands pass shoulder height. This shows whether the trunk or the arms pull.
technique.ski.kf.caption.finish: The hands are at their lowest, at the thighs. The trunk's fold is measured against the vertical.
technique.ski.kf.caption.recovery: The body rises. The dashed line shows the hip's height at the start.
technique.ski.kf.caption.sequence: One stroke in four positions. The curve is the wrist's path.
technique.ski.label.lead: The trunk starts {value} ms before the arms
technique.ski.label.lag: The arms start {value} ms before the trunk
technique.hint.knee_flex_top_deg: How much the knee is compressed
technique.hint.knee_lateral_cm: Per pedal revolution, the worse side
technique.hint.drive_ms: From when the hand starts moving down until it stops
technique.hint.recovery_ms: From the end of the drive to the next drive
technique.hint.recovery_ratio: How much longer the recovery is
technique.metric.elbow_angle_min_deg: Smallest elbow angle in the drive
technique.bikefit.check.section.bike: The bike's measurements, before and after
technique.bikefit.check.item.ball_over_a: Ball of the foot marked and over the pedal axle
technique.bikefit.check.item.saddle_heig: Saddle height (bottom bracket to saddle top)
technique.bikefit.check.note.leg_length: Leg length difference {mm} mm: consider a shim under the cleat of the shorter leg, and set the saddle height for the longer leg. Rule of thumb.
technique.bikefit.check.note.hamstring: Limited hamstring flexibility: a high saddle and a low handlebar become hard to hold. Keep the knee angle in the upper part of the range.
technique.bikefit.check.note.hamstring_l: Limited hamstring flexibility and a low trunk in the film: a higher handlebar makes the position easier to hold.
technique.bikefit.check.note.forefoot: A low arch or a varus forefoot together with a knee that falls inwards: try an insole with arch support or a wedge under the cleat.
technique.bikefit.check.note.big_change: The saddle height was changed {mm} mm at one visit. Changes that large are best made in steps over a few weeks.
technique.report.frames_lead.bikefit: Stills from the film in the positions that decide the set-up. The colour shows the value against its reference, and grey means the value is shown without a verdict.
technique.report.frames_lead.ski: Stills from one stroke. The colour shows the value against its reference, and what deviates is ringed.
technique.report.metrics_lead.bikefit: The median over {n} pedal revolutions. Only the knee angle at the bottom has a research-based reference. The other ranges are rules of thumb from bike fitting and are never shown as faults.
technique.report.metrics_lead.ski: The median over {n} strokes. The research on double poling is on snow and roller skis and gives directions, not angles for the SkiErg. All ranges here are therefore rules of thumb.
technique.report.sources: Sources of the reference values: {list}. The full list is in the program's documentation.
technique.report.disclaimer: The values are measured in two-dimensional video and are observations, not a diagnosis. Hip and knee angles carry an error of about ±5°.
technique.report.findings_lead: The most important first. Each point says what was measured, what it is compared with and what to do.
technique.report.advice_lead: The saddle height and the cleats are set on site. The stem is a recommendation to arrange yourself.
technique.report.checklist_lead: What the coach has examined and measured by hand, and the bike's measurements before and after.
technique.report.checklist_empty: The checklist is not filled in.
technique.report.compare_lead: Each value against the test on {date}. A change smaller than the measurement error counts as unchanged.
technique.report.compare_first: This is the first test. Next time every value is compared with this one.
technique.report.poor_note: Nothing is judged from this film. Film again as the warnings say.
technique.ui.checklist_saved: The checklist is saved and goes into the report.
technique.ui.no_keyframes: No key frames: the film could not be judged.
